acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

projectType.description:
The type of this project.
Enum type: {@link Genai.Project.Type}.
Default to production project.

retriever.description:
The retriever which will be used to answer queries for this project. If this is not set and the desired retriever
is a subtype of {@link Genai.Retriever.Dense}, then it must be specified
on the #unstructuredQueryEngineConfigName as {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config#vectorStore}.

results.description: All results from user queries for this project.

collections.description: All collections that have been indexed into the #retriever for this project.

readOnly.description: Whether this project is read-only (and therefore cannot be modified)

chunkerConfig.description: The chunker config used when indexing documents into the #retriever for this project.

groups.description: The groups with access to this project.

unstructuredQueryEngineConfigName.description:
The name of the {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config} for the {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine} for this project.
Either this or #queryOrchestratorConfigName should be specified for the project

queryOrchestratorConfigName.description:
The name of the {@link Genai.Agent.Config} for the {@link Genai.Agent.QueryOrchestrator}
Either this or #unstructuredQueryEngineConfigName should be specified for the project

sourceFilters.description:
Additional filters to apply on the documents in the #retriever when submitting queries to the project using #query
or #chatQuery. These filters are "AND'ed" with any existing filters on the {@link Genai.Query.Result} passed to the
querying functions.

See Genai.Query#filters

handlerTypeName.description:
The name of the {@link Genai.Query.Handler} type to which this project's queries will be routed.

Genai.Tutorial.REAEngine is deprecated and should not be used. Projects using Genai.Tutorial.REAEngine will
be migrated to use Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine instead.

title:
A Genai.Project encompasses a set of indexed (in the #retriever) documents and all configurations necessary to
answer queries based on those documents.

NOTE: Genai.Projects currently only support the R(E)A query engine.
name: Genai.Project
